newsitem.title: USA: Aon forms Affinity Insurance unit.
newsitem.headline: Aon forms Affinity Insurance unit.

text.p: Aon Specialty Group Inc said Tuesday it formed Affinity Insurance Services Inc, which will consist of the Aon Direct Group Inc, Aon Insurance Services Inc, Attorney's Advantage and Berkely/ARM subsidiaries.
Aon said its OUM and Keeling and Co units also will operate within the Affinity Insurance Services organization.

Robert Foys, president of Aon Direct Group, was named chairman and chief executive officer of the Affinity Insurance Services. Kevin Garvin, who previously served as executive vice president of Aon Direct Group, will be president and chief operating officer of the new company.
Aon Specialty Group is a subsidiary of Aon Group Inc, an insurance brokerage and consulting services organization. Aon Group is a subsidiary of Aon Corp, an insurance services holding company.
